query:
SELECT
                f.provider_id,
                f.parent_id,
                f.display_name,
                f.role,
                f.total_item_count,
                f.sync_enabled
            FROM
                email_mailbox_folders f
                JOIN email_links l ON l.id = f.link_id
            WHERE
                f.link_id = $1
                AND l.sync_generation = $2
                AND l.is_sync_active
                AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
